experiment.scope: Known voltages and independently calibrated specimen-plane shifts/tilts at each voltage. One shared geometry; objective pre/post halves have separate effective field lengths.

calibration_pixels.fitted_nuisance_parameters: Dose and background only, separately per frame.

prediction_pixels.fitted_nuisance_parameters: Dose and background only, separately per frame.

checks.scope: One complete simulated acquisition. Full local projector/condenser covariance; no proof of global uniqueness, repeated-noise coverage or real-field-profile accuracy. Known voltages and calibrated input shifts/tilts at both voltages are assumed.

fit.parameter_order: 16 projector solver coordinates, then 29 condenser native coordinates
fit.approximation: Local Gaussian image-analysis likelihood, full shared calibration covariance. Frozen original-pixel checks are required.

limits: One simulated acquisition, not repeated-noise coverage or a proof of global uniqueness.
Known voltage, detector response and calibrated input tilts/shifts at both voltages.
Coaxial round finite solenoids, independent Gaussian source waist at each voltage, zero lens offsets, no aberrations.
Objective pre/post halves are separate effective fields; current is fixed.
Known aperture diameter and order, repeatable uncalibrated aperture motion.
